name: Synthetic Sparse State

program.agency: None. ZY is a synthetic jurisdiction for engine tests.

rules.quote: The program may pay reasonable medical expenses.

rules.summary: Counseling is covered at up to $90 per hour.
rules.quote: The program may pay for counseling at not more than $90 per hour.

rules.summary: Transportation to treatment is covered up to $50 in total.
rules.quote: The program may pay for transportation to treatment, up to $50 in total.

rules.summary: Pain and suffering is not covered.
rules.quote: The program shall not pay for pain and suffering.

rules.summary: A claim needs at least 7 days of lost work.
rules.quote: A claim requires that the victim lost at least 7 days of work.

rules.summary: Report to police or a victim advocate, or have a protective order.
rules.quote: The crime shall be reported to law enforcement, or to a victim advocate, or be the subject of a protective order.

coverage.notes: Synthetic fixture with most categories missing, so the engines' fallbacks get tested.

researcher_notes: Synthetic jurisdiction for refengine tests and the differential test. Not a real program; the quotes were written for testing and are not law.
